scope: Retrospective accepted-work diagnostic on familiar development weeks; no new experiment or causal cost estimate.
method: Recover conditional solo fulfillment fees from the executed quote scenario outcomes using (revenue + penalty/2)/minimum quoted price as win probability. Average scenario conditional costs equally. Compare all realized driver-fee ledger lines for the same order, including later solo reposts. Exclude anchored acquisitions, cancelled orders and every order ever included in a multi-order posted gig; do not allocate shared fees.
limitations: Eligibility depends on later bundling and awards: this selected sample does not validate costs for all acquired or rejected work.
Scenario averages are not posterior probabilities conditional on winning; quote outcome rounding introduces small reconstruction error.
Menu option choice, later replanning and hypothetical quote payment multipliers can differ from realized execution; differences diagnose the combined forecast, not a causal component.
Panels have eight and six familiar overlapping seeds; order counts are not independent replication. This audit is not a policy comparison.
Driver fees exclude refunds, release fees, penalties and capacity value; no full economic-model validation is claimed.
